notes.title: Version update: Russian
notes.content:
This game has added Russian.

Sincere thanks to Russian translation volunteer Berry!

notes.title: Detail adjustments
notes.content: Significantly increase the stealth performance of Lurker.

notes.title: Game difficulty adjustments
notes.content:
Add "auto play" function and "space" key response to the dialogue interface.
Significantly reduce the time required to unlock new technologies.
Improve the leve up speed of "Reiki enhance".
Reduce the difficulty of "Nightmare Tasks".

notes.title: Fixed some bugs.
notes.content:
Fixed some bugs.
Fixed some localization display errors.
